environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster but namespace 'data-ops-prod' enforces Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' profile via namespace label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted' (KEP-2579). The admission controller rejects pods with spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged=true, spec.volumes[].hostPath of any type, runAsUser < 1000, and allowPrivilegeEscalation=true. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-types' (in enforce mode) independently validates that only 'configMap', 'emptyDir', 'projected', 'secret', and 'persistentVolumeClaim' volume types are permitted. The migration pod runs as UID 65534 (nobody) with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and drops ALL capabilities. The FILTER_OVERRIDE env var source ConfigMap 'migration-filters-prod' is managed by ArgoCD with a SealedSecret-style workflow where changes require approval in the GitOps repo (2-reviewer policy). Network policy restricts egress to only mongodb-prod.data-ops-prod.svc.cluster.local:27017 (which requires SCRAM-SHA-256 auth).

config.network_policy: egress restricted to mongodb-prod service only
